title: Provider & terms
text: Who provides your service, the terms you work under, and moving to another provider with all your data.

documents.title: Legal documents
documents.text: The documents in force for your account. The account owner accepts them.
documents.text_owner: Please read and accept the terms and the data processing agreement. The privacy notice is for information.
documents.agree: I have read "{title}" and accept it on behalf of my organization.

move.title: Move to another provider
move.text: Your data is yours. You can move your whole account, with all data, members and history, to another provider.
move.code_hint: Ask your new provider for a transfer code.
move.keeps: Everything moves: all data, members, roles, settings and history.
move.modules_off: These modules stop, because {list} are not offered by the new provider. Their data is kept.
move.plan_ends: Your current offer "{plan}" ends; the new provider sets your price.
move.support_ends: Open support access by your current provider ends.
move.invoices_stay_one: {count} unpaid invoice stays with your current provider.
move.invoices_stay_other: {count} unpaid invoices stay with your current provider.
move.partner_note: The move happens when {partner} accepts. Your current provider is told but cannot stop it.
move.consent: I agree to move this account, with all its data, to {partner}.
move.cancel_text: Your account stays where it is. The code you used cannot be used again.

partner.title: Transfers
partner.text: Clients moving to you and away from you. The client decides; you accept clients coming in.
partner.empty_incoming: No clients asking to move to you
partner.empty_incoming_text: Create a transfer code and give it to a client that wants to move to you.
partner.empty_outgoing_text: Clients that move to another provider appear here.
partner.modules_off: Modules you do not offer will stop: {list}
partner.accept_text: The account moves to you now, with all its data. Past invoices stay with its old provider.
partner.reject_text: The client sees your reason and stays with its provider.
partner.new_code_text: A one-time code for a client that wants to move to you.
partner.label: For whom
partner.label_hint: So you recognise the code later, e.g. the client’s name.
partner.code_once: Give this code to the client now. It is shown only once.
partner.codes_text: Each code works once, for one client, until it expires.
partner.revoke_text: The client can no longer use it.

legal.title: Legal documents
legal.text: The terms, privacy notice and data processing agreement your clients work under. Without your own, ours apply.
legal.new_text: A published version never changes. Clients are asked to accept a new version of the terms or the DPA.
legal.body_hint: Plain text. A line starting with "# " is a heading; a blank line starts a paragraph.
legal.summary_hint: Shown to clients when they are asked to accept.
legal.publish_text: It applies to all your clients from now on and cannot be changed afterwards.
legal.publish_text_accept: It applies to all your clients from now on and cannot be changed afterwards. Every client’s owner is asked to accept it.
legal.scope_partner_hint: Applies to One Solutions’ own clients.
legal.scope_platform_hint: The default for every partner that has not published its own. Their clients are asked to accept it.
legal.publish_text_platform: It becomes the default for every partner without its own version, from now on, and cannot be changed afterwards. Their clients’ owners are asked to accept it.
